chapter_seo_title: Starseizing Hand Unleashed – Ji Ning Battles the Dragon Whale King
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning's divine sense and sword formation fail to pierce the Dragon Whale King's defenses. He switches to close combat, unleashing the legendary Starseizing Hand in a fight that shakes the heavens.
og_title: When the Sword Isn't Enough – Ji Ning Brings Out the Big Guns
og_description: After his flying swords and soul attacks fail, Ji Ning activates Heavenly Transformation and the Starseizing Hand to face the 3,000-zhang Dragon Whale King up close.
twitter_title: Ji Ning vs Dragon Whale King – Close Combat Carnage
twitter_description: The Dragon Whale King shrugs off Ji Ning's attacks, so Ji Ning does what he does best: gets in its face with the Starseizing Hand.
